lines.text: The people of Israel argued that Absalom, whom they anointed, had died, so they should restore the king.
David sent word through Zadok and Abiathar that Amasa would command his army in place of Abner.
The men of Judah told the king to return, and they came to Gilgal to escort him across the Jordan.
Shimei, a Benjamite from Bahurim, hurried down with two thousand men of Benjamin and fell before the king.
Abishai wanted Shimei put to death for cursing the LORD's anointed, but David told Shimei he would not die.
